note: Machine-readable coupling axes for the git-commit hook and CI sweep. Each axis carries its own checklist so a report is actionable. Rules fire on ADDED diff content in production sources only — tests/ is exempt.

checklist: The reference target is `CodenameAurora.Core` (the only permitted inward dependency for operational modules)
OR the file is `CodenameAurora.App` (the composition root — the only project allowed to reference all modules)
No sibling operational module is referenced directly — cross-module communication goes through the core interfaces
If a new module is added, an architecture test covers it (Category=Architecture)
rules.message: ProjectReference added to a .csproj. Verify it only points to the core/contracts project (or that the file is the composition root). No horizontal references between sibling modules.

checklist: All implementors updated (grep the interface name across src/)
All call sites still compile (dotnet build --configuration Release)
Architecture tests still pass (dotnet test --filter Category=Architecture)
ADR created or updated in specs/adr/ if this is a structural decision
rules.message: Core/contracts interface touched. A changed interface signature is a cross-module contract change — verify all implementors and call sites.
